title: Vintage 70s Hearts Card Game Complete Set in Box Card 38 Card deck W Instruction
descriptionText:
Box is used but cards are mint. 

This vintage 70s Hearts card game set is a complete package that comes with a 38-card deck and instructions. The game is perfect for those who love strategy and want to experience the nostalgia of the 1970s. The set is in its original box and has not been modified.

The game is manufactured in China and does not come with any custom bundle. It is a great addition to any game collection and perfect for those who enjoy vintage card games. The year of production is 1970, making it a rare find for collectors. Get your hands on this classic game set today!
